# northflank_project (Resource)

Manages a Northflank project, the container for services, jobs, addons and secrets. A project runs either in a Northflank-managed `region` or on a bring-your-own-cloud cluster (`cluster_id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A project in a Northflank-managed region. Northflank derives the project ID
# from the name, here "my-application".
resource "northflank_project" "app" {
  name        = "My Application"
  description = "Services for my application."
  color       = "#EF233C"
  region      = "europe-west"
}

# A project on a bring-your-own-cloud cluster already registered with
# Northflank.
resource "northflank_project" "byoc" {
  name       = "BYOC Project"
  cluster_id = "gcp-cluster-1"

  # Also delete the project's services, jobs and addons on destroy. Without
  # this, destroying a project that is not empty fails.
  delete_child_objects = true
}

output "app_project_id" {
  value = northflank_project.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project, 3 to 39 characters. Changing this forces a new project, since Northflank derives the project `id` from it and cannot rename a project.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Bring-your-own-cloud cluster to host the project on. Conflicts with `region`. When the project runs in a Northflank region, this reports the managed cluster serving it. Changing this forces a new project.
- `color` (String) Hex color of the project in the Northflank dashboard, such as `#EF233C`. Northflank picks one when this is not set. The API does not report the color when reading a project, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported project shows it as unset until configured.
- `delete_child_objects` (Boolean) Whether destroying this resource also deletes the services, jobs, addons and other resources inside the project. When `false`, the default, destroying a project that is not empty fails instead. Only affects destroy; it is never sent to Northflank otherwise.
- `description` (String) Short description of the project, up to 200 characters. Removing it from configuration keeps the current value, since the API cannot clear it.
- `region` (String) Northflank region to host the project in, such as `europe-west`. Northflank picks a default when neither this nor `cluster_id` is set. Conflicts with `cluster_id`. Changing this forces a new project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the project, derived by Northflank from `name` (for example `my-project`). Used to address the project in the API and in other resources.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the project. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by their ID, shown in the dashboard URL and returned
# by the API: GET https://api.northflank.com/v1/projects
terraform import northflank_project.app my-application
```
